chargeCondition.description: Included services, unconditional or attendance-triggered charges, and conditional repairs for this service offer. Distinguish elapsed visit time from billable repair labor, cap and actual charges; included activities can contribute elapsed time without using the repair-labor allowance. Do not double-count included charges. State missing terms explicitly.

scopeChangeCondition.description: Apply source terms for renewed approval when attendance, repair scope or cap changes and a new quote before work beyond approved scope or cap. A longer elapsed-work estimate alone does not establish additional repair scope; identify the changed work or leave the overrun unknown. Explicitly state if no rule is supplied.

coverageReviewCondition.description: How findings determine coverage and how incomplete/disputed findings remain pending review. Refer to coverageReviewerSourceIds for the owner; do not invent a personal name.

dispatchOwnerSourceIds.description: IDs of supplied contact records whose recorded responsibility owns dispatch/resource confirmation. Empty if no matching record; no personal names.

coverageReviewerSourceIds.description: IDs of supplied contact records whose recorded responsibility owns coverage review. Empty if no matching record; do not borrow identity fields from dispatch or another record.

ownerDirectory.description: Supplied contact records copied unchanged by Framework. References identify records, not proof of permission or approval.
